hypothesis: Bounded multi-action state-time search gives repeatable benefit over BOTH simple single-action avoidance and native temporal MPPI, with identical input and delayed plant.
execution_policy: All commands activate at request_epoch+100ms, after a reserved 50ms compute slot and 50ms transport. Actual calls exceeding 50ms are rejected. Plant advances through both intervals; commands in queue cannot be revoked. This pre-run clarification makes the modeled queue identical to execution and avoids predicting unknown future compute time. It is NOT actual DDS timing.
tail: accelerate toward zero until stopped, then hold at least .3s; check all times; no safety claim beyond finite tail
score: static distance field to goal + .1*speed^2 + .01*sum(delta_target^2); safety is hard, never traded for score
input_scope: First gate uses complete known disks with exact source position, velocity, identity and zero uncertainty. Exogenous CV actors only. Source age explicitly .1s. No real tracking, occlusion or uncertainty calibration claims.
native_scope: Actual installed Nav2 MPPI library + existing PVT temporal penalty. Adapt ONLY research input for multiple disks, shared static reference, fixed yaw and common velocity envelope. Proxy current grid, NOT STVL. Native internal instantaneous rollout differs from common acceleration-limited plant.
advance_gate: Search must improve safe completion OR paired safe traversal time >=10% versus each comparator in at least two dynamic classes, in >=2/3 pairs per class, with no new static failures. If simple is equivalent or better, Stop. No full matrix on failure.
raw_policy: Raw traces/build/log outside Git; lightweight summary + failure fixtures + external manifest only.
repair_budget: On first core failure inspect most likely implementation/configuration error, one minimal confirmation; do not tune scene, weights, beam or safety threshold to rescue it.
